title.zh: 噪声与 fBm：程序化云和大理石

summary.zh: 从哈希函数出发写值噪声和梯度噪声，叠加成分形布朗运动，再用域扭曲做出流动的云和大理石。
summary.en: Build value and gradient noise from a hash, stack them into fractal Brownian motion, then domain-warp them into drifting clouds and marble.

zh: 把 octaves 调到 1，再逐步加到 8，观察细节如何一层层出现。
把 gain 调到 0.7 以上，图案会变得怎样粗糙？
写一个 ridged 版本：把 noise(p) 换成 1.0 - abs(noise(p))，做出山脊线。
en: Set octaves to 1, then raise it step by step to 8 and watch detail appear layer by layer.
Push gain above 0.7: how rough does the pattern get?
Write a ridged version by replacing noise(p) with 1.0 - abs(noise(p)) to get ridge lines.
